mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate CNS depressant effects of zolpidem through additive mechanisms and possible inhibition of zolpidem metabolism, with theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome although zolpidem is not primarily serotonergic.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if co-administration is necessary, use lowest zolpidem dose with close monitoring for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and serotonergic symptoms.
